tierReasoning: A bounded bug fix inside existing Remote Desktop admission: one optional host method and one fail-closed check. Every refused case stays refused except an asleep, unlocked Mac display; no new route, config, capability surface or helper change. Below the risk floor (new exported class), reasoning in the side-effects Tier section.

causalAutopsy.notes: Admission trusted the helper session flag, which display sleep sets on some Macs with no password in force (Studio, 2026-11-27).

classClosure.reason: at most one display wake per operator admission attempt, after the lockout and 10 s rate limit; up to 6 rereads over 3 s; no background loop or self-trigger
